title: UFO material seemed to communicate telepathically with Malmgren

And then he goes, they show him the UFO pieces. He feels the the debris. He feels this anomalous debris. It speaks to him telepathically

as_told.title: Malmgren shown UFO debris at Sandia that spoke to him telepathically
as_told.place_text: Sandia, Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: know, I interviewed a guy, Harold Malmgren, who basically on his deathbed said that he held in his hands UFO material from that came out of the plume of a blast from Operation Bluegill Triple Prime, and it was given to him by Jeff Bezos's maternal grandfather, Lawrence Preston Geise, at Sandia National Labs and Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico.

as_told.title: Malmgren held UFO material from the Bluegill Triple Prime blast plume
as_told.place_text: Sandia National Labs / Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico; Pacific test site

plain: A presidential advisor named Harald Malmgren is said to have held pieces of a UFO in 1962, and he "heard words in his head" when he touched them, as if the material were speaking to him telepathically. Michels tells this on three episodes, relaying Malmgren, a source he names as Pippa Malmgren, and a man named Lawrence Preston Gise, whom Michels calls Jeff Bezos's maternal grandfather and who he says handed over the pieces. The tellings differ: one puts the handling at Los Alamos, the others at Sandia National Labs and Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico, and the last calls it a deathbed claim that the material came out of the plume of a test blast called Bluegill Triple Prime, without mentioning telepathy.
